title: EEVblog 1547 (Part 1) - Contacting the Voyager 2 Space Probe
summary: EEVblog interviews Richard Stephenson of NASA's Canberra Deep Space Communications Complex about how the 70m DSS-43 dish is used to contact Voyager 2. It covers the ground antenna and low-noise receiver side of deep space communication. This is a 2023 re-release of a 2017 video.
why: Shared in Voyager news threads as an accessible look at the real equipment used to talk to the probes.

quote.text: These three videos by EEVblog detail the ground based antennas and how it is contacted
